text:
elaine (Sales): Ok team — hearing back from Acadia on the POC. They pushed DPA redlines + want KMS attestation, plus they asked for Net60 on the PO. Also DocuSign API is blocked for their security team; need fallback for signatures. What's our path to finalize MSA + order form so we can start Dedicated capacity for POC?

Matt (Legal): Can you paste the DPA paragraph? if it's standard subproc wording we can accept w/ addendum. KMS attestation — need HSM attestation + sig from infra. Net60 is ok but needs finance signoff + sales credit hold. For e-sign fallback: we can accept signed PDF via secure upload + audit trail. Wet-ink only for large deals. Paste the clause and I can draft an addendum.

elaine (Sales): Pasted clause: ```Subprocessor: Vendor may engage subprocessors subject to written notice. Customer may require KMS attestations and separate addendum.```
Also Acadia says DocuSign IP ranges blocked on their gateway — they asked for manual countersign via email or portal upload.

Matt (Legal): Suggest tweak: `Customer may require reasonable KMS attestations; Vendor will provide attestation or HSM certificate within 10 business days of request.` If that works I'll add it to the DPA as a short addendum. For signature, propose: "signed PDF uploaded to secure portal with audit trail + mirrored email acknowledgement" — legal ok with that. @Jordan (Finance) please confirm credit/Net terms on PO.

Jordan (Finance): Net60 is fine for the POC only if we set a $50k prepay hold or run credit. If PO estimate is < $25k we can do Net30. Also need invoice to include PO number and remit instructions.

Sam (Eng): On the infra side: POC Dedicated onboarding is ~3 weeks after contracts are signed. KMS/HSM attestation will require infra to run a short attestation flow; we need legal to limit scope to production endpoints. Also Acadia requested SOC2 — link to our report: https://redwood.example/soc2-2025.

contracts-bot: Document uploaded: https://secure.docs/redwood/Acadia/MSA_redline_v3.pdf — checklist created: [ ] KMS addendum [ ] CFO approval for Net60 [ ] Signature method confirmed [ ] Onboarding SLA annex.

elaine (Sales): I'll ask Acadia if they can 1) allow our DocuSign endpoint IP 3.24.18.0/24 temporarily or 2) upload signed PDF to the secure portal link above. Matt — can you draft the KMS addendum this afternoon? Jordan: estimate PO amount for POC is ~18k.

Matt (Legal): I can draft a minimal addendum today with the 10 business day attestation clause and the portal signature language. Will also add language limiting HSM attestation scope to relevant keys.

Jordan (Finance): Confirmed — PO ~18k => Net30 ok. If they push Net60 escalate to me and I'll request credit hold.

Sam (Eng): FYI if they pivot to on-prem HSM we need a 6-8 week timeline. Flagging as blocker for schedule.

elaine (Sales): Great — I'll update after Acadia responds about signature method and send the PO when they confirm. Thanks all :thumbsup:
